content:
Ben (Recruiter): FYI candidate Priyanka Rao (Data Infra Eng) got a counteroffer. She's remote EU (Spain) and asking for T3->T4 band uplift + a tax gross-up on the sign-on because of cross-border payroll + an earlier start (3 weeks). Current approved: base €72,000 + €8k sign-on + standard RS. Can we expedite? cc @Maya

Maya (Hiring Manager): Priyanka is the only candidate with our required Kafka+K8s experience in time for the Q4 rollout. I can free up cloud budget for one quarter to cover uplift if needed.

Aisha (People Ops): Two policy angles here: cross-border payroll can cause net-pay differences; gross-up is allowed in rare cases with Finance & Legal sign-off. Band uplift for remote EU hires also needs comp parity check vs UK/DE bands. For EOD decision we need manager justification, Priya comp sign-off, finance gross-up cap, and legal on payroll wording.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): We can approve a local-market uplift if parity breach shown. For Spain we typically cap at +7% base without committee if manager justifies and finance confirms headroom. Sign-on gross-up: we can backstop tax equalization on a one-time payment up to €5,000 but anything above needs exec review. Need written justification here.

Ben (Recruiter): Candidate prefers cash (no RS acceleration) and needs visibility on net pay due to Spanish payroll deductions. Also requests start 3 weeks earlier because spouse has a visa slot.

Elena (Finance): Quick budget check: we have up to €10,000 in EU hiring contingency this quarter. Gross-up reserve would eat into that. If gross-up + uplift > €10k, escalate to VP Finance.

Aisha (People Ops): Steps to close quickly:
- Maya: paste 2-sentence manager justification explaining urgency and parity risk.
- Priya: reply with "approve parity uplift" and exact uplift % and gross-up cap.
- Elena: ACK funding cap.
- Sam: confirm payroll/legal wording for gross-up and any contract clause.
- Ben: send revised offer with explicit gross-up example showing net pay.

Maya (Hiring Manager): Justification: Priyanka's infra skills shorten our integration timeline by 6 weeks; losing her means a multi-month vendor delay. Parity uplift prevents an easy loss to the counteroffer and keeps the team on schedule.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): approve parity uplift: +6% base (€72,000 -> €76,320) as a local-market uplift without committee. Approve sign-on tax gross-up up to €4,500 one-time to cover estimated payroll tax delta. RS unchanged. Candidate must accept gross-up terms and provide a completed tax net-pay worksheet before offer finalization.

Elena (Finance): ACK: up to €10k total from EU hiring contingency; this request fits within that (uplift + gross-up total ~€8,820). If paperwork shows larger tax exposure, escalate to VP Finance.

Sam (Legal): I'll add clause language to the offer that clarifies gross-up mechanics and that Redwood will provide a one-time gross-up payment capped at €4,500, subject to tax documentation. Also include start-date contingency for visa slot. No change to equity vesting.

CompBot: Reminder: document exception in Comp Exceptions tracker with tags [EU, gross-up, parity-uplift].

Ben (Recruiter): I'll compute a net-pay example for Spain with the gross-up and attach to the offer. Candidate prefers acceptance if we can show net parity. Sending revised offer now and will post signed doc. Thanks all :pray:
